description:
Morgan is a half-magi and needs to find the right man for her magical powers to develop. Will she be able to find the man she was destined to be with?

**Original Webtoon:**  
KToon, [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10275145), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/muggles_law), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/62865147)
